item.title: NZ-0001: Where Does the Nile Really Begin?
item.description: The question sounds simple — but exposes centuries of colonial cartography, contested science, and the deep complexity of a river that drains 3.3 million square kilometres across eleven nations.
item.content:encoded:
Article ID: NZ-0001 | HYD-0001

The question sounds deceptively simple. The answer requires confronting colonial cartography, competing hydrological definitions, a lake in Uganda, and two thousand kilometres of ambiguity.

Read the full article at nilezon.com
